description.value:
Frequency 1/round

Spend your action lining up instead of firing. Your next Strike against that Mark before the start of your next turn deals full precision damage — an extra 2d8 (3d8 at Veteran, 4d8 at Undying) — whether or not it crits.

cinderfall.incomplete: Base +2d8 precision damage on your next Strike vs. your Marked quarry is built as a 1-round self-effect (turn-start expiry) carrying a DamageDice keyed to target:mark:quarry, matching Ranger's Precision classfeature pattern. Substitution: the card says "your NEXT Strike" (singular); the effect instead grants the bonus to any Strike vs. the quarry for its full 1-round window rather than tracking single-use consumption, since real pf2e's own closest analog (Precision) only tracks "first hit each round," not "exactly one Strike," and no first-class consumption tracker exists to encode the stricter reading -- in practice the window is short enough (until the start of your next turn) that this rarely differs from the stated text. NOT built: the tiered escalation (+3d8 at "Veteran", +4d8 at "Undying") -- those tier names are undefined anywhere in the corpus (see Vanish Between Blinks' note for the full cross-check); left as a decision point rather than guessed.
